package.name: bonbon_ui_api_bringup
package.description: Pi-1 bringup: composes bonbon_operator_api (dashboard/operator API serving the 10.1" touchscreen), bonbon_fault_manager (component fault registry, co-located here since the dashboard is its primary consumer), and cross-Pi liveness/authority (self_id=pi1) into ONE launch for the System UI/API Pi. Pi-1 owns no HAL hardware (no AI HAT, no sensors/actuators per the BOM) -- this package launches no bonbon_hal nodes at all, unlike the Pi-2/Pi-3 bringups. This package launches no node code of its own -- it is composition only.
